title: LLMs Are Biased Towards Output Formats! Systematically Evaluating and Mitigating Output Format Bias of LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating and comparing model performance metrics (such as estimated true accuracy and F1 scores) and format-instruction following rates across various specified output formats (e.g., JSON vs. YAML, bullet points vs. Python lists, character vs. textual multiple-choice identifiers) for the same underlying question-answering and reasoning tasks.
